what_its_for: Candesartan is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) and heart failure. Lowering high blood pressure helps prevent strokes, heart attacks, and kidney problems. It belongs to a group of medicines called ARBs (angiotensin receptor blockers), which work by relaxing your blood vessels so your heart does not have to work as hard.
how_to_take: Take candesartan by mouth with or without food — it does not matter. Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Try to take it at the same time each day to help you remember. Do not stop taking this medicine without talking to your doctor first, even if you feel fine. Stopping suddenly can cause your blood pressure to spike.
dosing: Your doctor will decide the right dose for you. For high blood pressure, the usual starting dose in adults is 8 mg to 16 mg once a day, which may be increased up to 32 mg once daily. For heart failure, doses typically start lower and are slowly increased. Always follow your doctor's instructions exactly and do not change your dose on your own.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember — unless it is almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Never take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store candesartan at room temperature, between 59°F and 86°F (15°C to 30°C). Keep it away from heat, moisture, and direct sunlight. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep all medicines out of reach of children and pets. Dispose of unused or expired tablets safely — ask your pharmacist about medicine take-back programs.
what_to_avoid: Avoid potassium supplements, salt substitutes containing potassium, or high-potassium foods (like bananas and oranges in very large amounts) unless your doctor approves, as candesartan can raise potassium levels. Avoid alcohol, as it can lower your blood pressure further and cause dizziness. Do not take non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) like ibuprofen or naproxen regularly without asking your doctor, as they can reduce how well candesartan works and may harm your kidneys. Avoid getting up too quickly from sitting or lying down, as this can cause dizziness.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away or go to the emergency room if you experience: swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat (signs of a serious allergic reaction called angioedema); difficulty breathing or swallowing; severe dizziness or fainting; little or no urination; muscle weakness or irregular heartbeat (possible signs of high potassium); chest pain; or if you become pregnant while taking this medicine. Also call your doctor if you feel unusually tired, have persistent vomiting or diarrhea, or if your blood pressure readings are much higher or lower than usual.
when_it_works: You may start to see your blood pressure lower within 2 weeks of starting candesartan, but it may take up to 4 to 6 weeks to get the full benefit. Keep taking it every day even if you feel well — high blood pressure often has no symptoms. Do not stop taking it just because you feel better.
special_populations: PREGNANCY: Do NOT take candesartan if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It can cause serious harm or death to an unborn baby, especially during the second and third trimesters. Tell your doctor immediately if you become pregnant. Use effective birth control while taking this medicine. BREASTFEEDING: It is not known if candesartan passes into breast milk. Talk to your doctor before breastfeeding. CHILDREN: Candesartan can be used in children aged 1 year and older for high blood pressure, but the dose is based on weight. It is not approved for heart failure in children. ELDERLY: Older adults may be more sensitive to the blood pressure-lowering effects and dizziness. Use with caution and follow your doctor's dosing instructions carefully. KIDNEY OR LIVER PROBLEMS: Your doctor may start you on a lower dose if you have kidney or liver disease. Regular monitoring of kidney function and blood electrolytes (like potassium) will be needed.
